lines.say: FSH and LH activity like its own, from women's urine; most LH activity comes from hCG
supports multiple-egg development for IVF; pregnancies no worse than recombinant FSH
gonadotropins started sperm production in about 75% of men with low LH and FSH (off-label)
earlier testosterone didn't lower success here; says nothing about recovery after steroids
ultrasound and estradiol track how they respond
FSH checked first to rule out ovarian failure; in men, LH and testosterone too
ovarian hyperstimulation in 7.2%, and 35% of pregnancies were multiples, in a trial
blood clots and lung complications, with rare deaths
